method: Each case calls one export with "args" and records "value" or the thrown "error" message; the replay must match both exactly (strings, numbers and style objects deep-equal). {"$":"undefined"|"NaN"|"Infinity"|"-Infinity"} stand for those values; easing names stand for the Easing functions. Excluded as intentional divergences: {"skewFourArguments":24,"malformedUnitStrings":9,"qUnitStrings":32}. skewFourArguments: the reference rejects the documented skew(number, unit, number, unit) form; the replay follows the docs. malformedUnitStrings: the reference accepts junk such as "5apx", " 5px", ".px" and the replay rejects anything but <number><unit>. qUnitStrings: the reference rejects "5Q" style strings; the replay accepts them. interpolateStyles excludes NaN inputs or values, unknown extrapolation names (the replay throws like interpolate()), nested functions such as f(g(1)), and colour functions nested inside another function such as drop-shadow(... rgba(...)). Easing.circle and Easing.bounce are not used because core Easing returns other values than the reference outside [0, 1].
